font.reason: A variable, neutral Persian product-UI sans that retains the compact, high-contrast role of the source Helvetica while rendering joined Persian labels cleanly at the picker's small row size.

translations.AI: AI (retained as a familiar Latin technical mark, isolated with bdi)

rtlDecisions.action: Applied RTL through FaRoot; each icon is the flex-start item and therefore sits at the right/start side of its Persian label.
rtlDecisions.why: The icon-label relationship follows reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Placed the badge at the equivalent right exterior position in the centered symmetric composition; preserved its dimensions and fade timing. Restored the source-like system Latin sans and bidi-isolated AI.
rtlDecisions.why: The badge remains balanced beside a symmetric centered picker; the Latin technical mark keeps its source typography.

rtlDecisions.action: Replaced only the visible refresh glyph in row six with a 16px inline SVG open circular arrow, using currentColor and the original icon opacity falloff.
rtlDecisions.why: The U+21BA font glyph rendered as a hook even with a system symbol font stack. The SVG makes the source's refresh-arrow meaning explicit and renders consistently.

rtlDecisions.what: Picker movement, item sequence, centre pill, falloff and gradient
rtlDecisions.action: Kept unchanged: vertical translateY, fixed focus pill, vertical gradient, list order, opacity/font-size distance mapping, outQuint easing, five holds and scaleY landing breath.
rtlDecisions.why: These are vertical/physical interaction semantics, not left-to-right reading semantics. The source prompt requires content to move through an immobile focus pill and pause after every snap.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the picker and pill left/right bounds and centre anchoring unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: They define a centred symmetric composition; mirroring would produce the same geometry.

typography.letterSpacing: No tracking on Persian labels. The source's 0.5px tracking is preserved only on the Latin AI mark.
typography.shaping: Labels are intact text runs; no Persian characters are split, transformed individually or uppercased.
typography.fit: Persian sizes use the shared fs/faText scaling. All labels stay on one line inside the 300px design viewport in inspected frames.

rasterHandling.assets: None. The card is fully vector/CSS text and geometry.
rasterHandling.foreignText: All source feature labels were replaced; the intentional AI technical mark remains.

motionFidelity.details: PICKER_CAROUSEL_FEATURE_CYCLE_DURATION remains 108. FPS, stage size, five snap steps, HOLD=5/14, easing, row height, opacity/size falloff, and landing breath are unchanged. Translation length does not change any timing because labels are whole-row content rather than character-timed animation.

verification.comparison: Viewed Persian and original paired renders across entry, cycle/settle sequences, and final resting frames. After the SVG fix, freshly rendered and compared frames 90 and 107. The icon now clearly reads as an open circular refresh arrow at the RTL start of the selected label; the previous hooked fallback glyph is gone. The Persian label remains on one line, and the fixed pill, badge position and vertical composition still match their intended source roles.
verification.finalRender: PickerCarouselFeatureCycle.fa.mp4 rendered successfully with --video; harness returned ok:true and no errors.

lessons.symptom: U+21BA refresh rendered as a small hooked letterform after adding a system symbol font stack.
lessons.cause: The render environment still resolves that code point through an unsuitable glyph fallback.
lessons.fix: Use a small inline SVG with currentColor and the existing opacity animation for meaning-critical symbols when font fallback cannot be verified visually.

newLessons: A system symbol font stack did not reliably render U+21BA in this Remotion environment; a currentColor inline SVG preserved the refresh meaning and existing opacity timing.
